The stub marker is the constant VSDD-STUB (built as "VSDD-" + "STUB" in gatelib.py), searched in every tracked source-class file at the head; a hit fails the green gate naming the file, before any command runs.

The criterion regex is ac(\d+)(?!\d), so test_ac12 does not cover AC-1 (test_criteria_need_a_non_digit). The classname-to-file rule is the longest prefix of the classname that equals or ends the extension-less path of exactly one tests-class file, returning the file with its extension; two candidates give no file (test_file_from_attribute_then_classname). The e2e sample runner writes file on every testcase and type on failure/error nodes, so the red gate reads the attribute (test_sample_runner_writes_file_and_type).
